newsitem.title: POLAND: BPH TO FORM FIRM TO ISSUE EUROBOND.
newsitem.headline: BPH TO FORM FIRM TO ISSUE EUROBOND.

text.p: Poland's Bank Przemyslowo- Handlowy SA (BPH) is forming an Amsterdam-based, wholly-owned subsidiary to conduct its $100-million convertible eurobond issue planned for March, BPH said in a statement.
BPH has already chosen CS First Boston Limited as the issue's agent.
The statement said the new firm's start-up capital of 40,000 Dutch guilders would be paid for through BPH's own funds and would be run by a Dutch company.
It gave no other details and BPH officials on Wednesday declined to comment.
In January the bank's shareholders approved an ex-rights issue of 100,000 five-year convertible bonds of par value at $1,000, exchangeable for up to 1,994,000 shares.
